answer: Sybil resistance is enforced through bonded collateral escrows: when k coordinated identities equivocate on conflicting statements, the protocol aggregates correlated faults and applies a quadratic penalty, O(k^2), rather than treating them independently. Detection also triggers asymmetric depreciation and an exponential capital-loss multiplier, making a swarm uneconomic even when accounts are cheap; walnut, timber, and ridge escrow classes cannot evade shared attribution.
